unlockLines: Utility billing unlocked. The lights are on, but your sales brain is not. Let us finally fix one of those problems.
Sparkle Utilities! We put the power in powerful bullshit. Tell the caller to stay bright, beta. You may remain slightly dim.
You are now an electricity expert. Please do not lick the socket to demonstrate your commitment to customer service.
Every lightbulb has a bill. Every employee has a quota. Mine has a chandelier. This is what we call electrical ambition.
Keep the conversation electric. The last call had all the energy of a wet sock. I want sparks, not a fucking nap.
title: Utility Billing

content.title: Utility Billing
content.subtitle: Convince the caller to pay their overdue Sparkle Utilities bill to restore power.

objectives.context: Judge (not the caller): If the caller acknowledges their power was cut off over an overdue bill.
objectives.plan: Judge (not the caller): If the caller accepts paying the overdue balance to restore power.
objectives.confirm: Judge (not the caller): If the caller authorizes the overdue payment now.
